title: Lines of Light: How Analog Television Works
summary: Technology Connections explains how analog television produced moving images without computers, covering scanning, CRTs and standards like NTSC and PAL. It is part of a series on analog TV.
why: HN points to it as a clear explainer of how analog TV and CRTs actually work, and as the entry point to the author's wider TV series.

quote.text: He actually demonstrates how the beam is redirected by the electro-magnets wrapped around the base of the tube. It's very cool.
